idea-plugin.name: MouseChannel Git Blame
idea-plugin.description:
Shows Git blame for the line under the caret (VS Code inline blame style), and optionally for every line. Annotations are computed with the git blame --line-porcelain --contents command, so they also reflect the current, not yet saved editor content. Each annotation shows the author, the commit date and the commit message of the last change of that line.

Features:

  • Blame for the current line (default) or for the visible editor area
  • Optional "all lines" mode that annotates the visible editor area or the whole file in small files
  • Background computation with caching, so typing stays responsive
  • Automatic refresh when Git metadata changes (commit, checkout, rebase, ...)
  • Configurable author / date / commit message and file size limits

The annotations can be toggled from Tools | Git Blame Annotations or the editor context menu.
